source_text: Omnibus diebus seniorum qui longiorum dierum fuerunt post Iesum. Longi dies sunt qui cognitione operum Dei extenduntur. Breves dies malorum. Qui viderunt opera Domini magna — experientia confirmat fidem. Post Iesum seniores ecclesiae qui mysteria viderunt prolongant dies salutis in populo.
pass_a_gloss: All days of-elders who of-longer days were after Jesus. Long days are which by-knowledge of-works of-God are-extended. Short days of-evils. Who saw works of-Lord great — experience confirms faith. After Jesus elders of-church who mysteries saw prolong days of-salvation in people.
pass_b_english: [[All the days of the elders who outlived Jesus and had seen all the Lord’s great works >> Bible:Judges 2:7]]. Long days are those stretched by knowing God’s works; the wicked’s days are short. Those who saw the Lord’s great works — experience confirms faith. After Jesus, the church’s elders who have seen the mysteries lengthen salvation’s days among the people.
